notes:
Founder-led early stage SaaS (two founders + 6 engineers). Primary product: meeting notes & knowledge search for SMBs. Came in via blog post about hosted inference cost comparison.

Summary from discovery call:
- Founder (Alyssa Morgan) is price-sensitive; wants clear per-token numbers and realistic monthly bill for 50 active users.
- Use-case: ingest meeting transcripts, return condensed summaries + short Q/A. Typical prompt size ~1.5k tokens, response ~200-400 tokens.
- Latency requirement: perceived snappy UX; target p95 generation <= 400ms for canned summary flows, okay to be higher for long-context reruns.
- Throughput target: steady-state ~20-50 requests/sec during daytime peak. Bursts to 100 req/s acceptable.
- Cost sensitivity: startup runway constraints; prefers predictable per-month pricing or committed credits.
- Model preference: open to cost/lightweight models for summaries; comparing 'base-llama' style open models vs Anthropic/OPENAI for quality. Wants a short A/B plan.
- Security: public cloud acceptable; requires SSO for admin console and audit logs. No strict residency needs.

Founder quotes: "We just need honest numbers — what will this cost us at scale and at prototype stage. Don’t give me a thousand caveats."

POC proposal we discussed:
- 2-week proof-of-concept using hosted API, 50k tokens/day budget cap.
- Provide sample cost calc (tokens->$) with three model tiers and suggested fallback for cost control.
- Add sample latency profile from Redwood public benchmarks for context.

Open items / Ask from AE/SE:
- Provide simplified pricing matrix + 3-month cost projection (low/typical/high).
- Run quick internal bench of generating 200-token summary from their 1.5k-token prompt (target p95).
- Prepare short A/B guidance comparing expected quality/cost tradeoffs vs OpenAI/Anthropic for summarization workloads.
